title: 第17章 一些美妙的误会第18章 你是一只舔狗
content_zh:
落霞峰执法堂弟子想了想后，说道，
“不是，今天外门弟子那边好像送来了一份登记，说那个王冕，跟道侣张秀搬到外门弟子住所那边去了，那个房子里现在只有韩风一个人。”
“这个韩风是什么修为？”
“修为？他有个屁的修为啊，远近闻名的废人，进山门五年都没练出来灵气，整个落霞峰第一废，本来下个月就要赶出宗门了，结果走了狗屎运，让你妹妹选成了道侣。
这事儿你们姜家运作一下，他指定赶不走了。”
姜怀阳沉吟片刻后，点了点头，说道，
“行吧，那个韩风，他是不是有一只白色的灵狐？”
“这谁知道呢，我没事可不会去关注一个杂役弟子。”
“行吧，多谢师兄，在下告辞。”
“不送了。”
姜怀阳和尖脸师弟离开了落霞峰，径直向着灵兽峰飞去。
尖脸师弟问道，
“师兄，那小子是个不能修炼的废人？那不扯犊子嘛，就那小子秒杀练气五层修士时的干脆利落劲儿，至少也得是七八层的修为吧。
他这个年纪，练气七八层，怎么着也算是资质好的那一类了吧。”
“我也觉得这件事有点不寻常，这小子引起我兴趣了，现在咱去灵兽峰问问，就能确定了。”
姜怀阳面色如常，来到了灵兽峰的登记处，直接走了进去。
里面坐着的，还是那个叶家弟子。
“哟，执法堂的师兄，有什么事吗？”
叶家弟子赶忙站起身问道。
姜怀阳问道，

“今天或者最近，有没有一个带着白狐狸来登记的弟子？”
姜怀阳是在灵兽峰山脚下见到韩风遇刺的，而一个外峰弟子，来灵兽峰，除了购买登记灵兽，应该就没别的事情了。
叶家弟子心头一颤，但还是赶忙说道，
“有啊，这不是巧了嘛，就在大半个时辰前，还有一个弟子过来登记一只通灵玉狐呢。”
“哦？叫什么名字？”
“我看看啊。”
叶家弟子装模作样的打开了册子，看了一下后，说道，
“叫韩风。”
“哦，叫韩风啊。”
姜怀阳淡然的点了点头，丝毫没有惊讶的表情，转身要走的时候，忽然转头看向那个弟子，说道，
“你叫什么名字？”
那弟子闻言一怔，说道，
“我叫叶龙泉。”
“叶家的人？”
“是。”
“好，我知道了。”
姜怀阳走了出去。
现在可以确定，刚刚那个反杀刺客的弟子，就是韩风。
他五年前进入宗门，十八岁的年纪，一直都是杂役，却有着练气期七八层的修为，而且看速度和出手时对灵气的掌控，至少也是上品灵根以上吧，搞不好还是地灵根呢。
可他为什么不去成为外门弟子呢？

一个只会种药草的杂役弟子，为何杀人时这么果断干脆呢？
他那把很厉害的剑，是哪来的呢？
content_en:
After thinking for a while, the disciple of Luoxia Peak Law Enforcement Hall said,
"No, it seems that a registration was sent from the outer disciples today, saying that Wang Mian and his Taoist companion Zhang Xiu moved to the residence of the outer disciples. Now there is only Han Feng in that house."
"What kind of cultivation level does this Han Feng have?"
"Cultivation? He has a shitty cultivation level. He is a well-known cripple. He has not been able to develop spiritual energy for five years after entering the mountain sect. He is the first cripple in Luoxia Peak. He was supposed to be kicked out of the sect next month, but he got so lucky that your sister was chosen as a Taoist companion.
You Jiang family should work on this matter, he will definitely not be driven away. "
After Jiang Huaiyang pondered for a moment, he nodded and said,
"Okay, that Han Feng, does he have a white spirit fox?"
"Who knows, I won't pay attention to a handyman disciple if I have nothing to do."
"Okay, thank you, senior brother, and I'll take my leave."
"I won't give it away."
Jiang Huaiyang and his sharp-faced junior brother left Luoxia Peak and flew straight towards Spirit Beast Peak.
The sharp-faced junior brother asked,
"Senior brother, is that kid a loser who can't practice? That's nonsense. The way that kid killed a fifth-level Qi-training monk so swiftly and swiftly, he must be at least a seventh- or eighth-level practitioner.
At his age, he is at the seventh or eighth level of qi training, so he can be regarded as one with good qualifications. "
"I also think this matter is a bit unusual. This guy has aroused my interest. Now let's go to Spirit Beast Peak and ask, so we can be sure."
With a normal expression on his face, Jiang Huaiyang arrived at the registration office of Spirit Beast Peak and walked in directly.
Sitting inside was still the Ye family disciple.
"Hey, Senior Brother from the Law Enforcement Hall, what's the matter?"
The Ye family disciple quickly stood up and asked.
Jiang Huaiyang asked,
"Is there a disciple who brought a white fox to register today or recently?"
Jiang Huaiyang saw Han Feng being assassinated at the foot of Spirit Beast Peak. As a disciple from outside the peak, he probably had nothing to do when he came to Spirit Beast Peak except to buy and register spirit beasts.
The Ye family disciple's heart trembled, but he still hurriedly said,
"Yes, isn't it a coincidence? Just half an hour ago, another disciple came over to register a psychic jade fox."
"Oh? What's your name?"
"Let me take a look."
The disciple of the Ye family pretended to open the booklet, looked at it, and said,
"My name is Han Feng."
"Oh, my name is Han Feng."
Jiang Huaiyang nodded calmly, without any expression of surprise. When he turned to leave, he suddenly turned to look at the disciple and said,
"What's your name?"
The disciple was startled when he heard this and said,
"My name is Ye Longquan."
"A member of the Ye family?"
"Yes."
"Okay, I get it."
Jiang Huaiyang walked out.
Now it is certain that the disciple who just killed the assassin was Han Feng.
He entered the sect five years ago. At the age of eighteen, he has always been a handyman, but he has a cultivation level of seventh or eighth level in the Qi training period. And judging from his speed and control of the spiritual energy when shooting, he must be at least a high-grade spiritual root or above. Maybe he is still an earth spiritual root.
But why doesn't he become an outer disciple?
Why is a handyman disciple who can only grow medicinal herbs so decisive and straightforward when killing people?
Where did his powerful sword come from?
